title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Full descriptions validated on LinkedIn. Scores measure skill and domain fit.
latest_update: Latest update: October 5, 2026 — full-read pass: all 263 LinkedIn listings from the 67 mandatory passes were read from their full descriptions; 6 new roles filed (Exo IaC 8, Conga 7, Onepoint DevOps IA 6, Tecsys DevOps 6, NTT DATA 5, Coinbase 5).

notes_sections.heading: October 5 full-read pass (Marc: open more, do not filter by company)
items: Re-collected every LinkedIn result for the 67 mandatory passes over the past 7 days — 263 unique in-family-title listings (obvious non-engineering titles removed) — and pulled the full description of every one through the public job-description endpoint. Each was scored from the text, not the title; employers already in applications.md were matched by role, not company (CARET Senior DevOps, Keyfactor Senior DevOps, MongoDB SRE and Onepoint/Crown Corp DevSecOps are the same roles Marc already Applied to, so they were left alone).

209 listings had substantive DevOps/SRE/infrastructure content; their Remote/Hybrid/On-site labels were read from the job pages (55 remote, 91 hybrid, 57 on-site, 6 unlabelled). Of the 89 that were remote or hybrid in a reachable city, about 25 were opened for a closer read of duties, requirements, pay and office cadence.

Filed (6): Exo IaC Developer (8), Conga Sr. SWE DevOps (7), Onepoint DevOps IA (6), Tecsys Ingénieur DevOps (6), NTT DATA DevOps CI/CD (5), Coinbase Core Reliability (5). Hybrid cadence and pay are unconfirmed for several — each ledger row says what to confirm.

Not read beyond the summary line: roughly 60 remote/hybrid listings whose titles are software-engineering roles (Affirm, Cohere, Thumbtack ML infrastructure, AI/forward-deployed engineers) and network/security engineering roles; they rank low on DevOps content in the description.

notes_sections.heading: October 5 follow-up — skimmed roles now opened
items: The four roles skimmed on October 1 plus Alithya were opened in full (public job-description endpoint): Alithya Azure DevOps Consultant (6, filed), Deel SRE (5, filed), Jane App Staff Cloud Engineering (4 — AWS gate), Rightsline (4 — at the pay floor), Scribd (4). MaintainX SRE stays unconfirmed (remote eligibility from Ontario).
Per Marc’s direction the shortlist rule is now “open more, filter less”; the ~150 listings triaged by title/workplace label on the 10-01 and 10-05 runs have not yet been re-read in full.

notes_sections.heading: October 5 run (complete)
items: Past-3-days listing endpoint (read-only; ignores the Remote filter) for every mandatory pass: 14 phrases for Canada, 11 hubs x 3 titles, Ottawa/Kingston/Cornwall/Montréal x 5 titles. All returned results except Kingston (Cloud Platform, DevOps and SRE passes: Zero results) — Kingston/Cornwall rely on the same broadened fallback as before. New IDs above the previous run's newest (4474517023) were filtered to in-family titles, then each listing's Remote/Hybrid/On-site label was read from its job page. Of 23 in-family new listings the labels were mostly Remote (Kinaxis Cloud Engineer 2 appears as many location-indexed copies), with Coveo FDE and Kinaxis Ottawa/Toronto as Hybrid. Opened in full: Larouche Raymond, Blue J. Network Solutions Senior DevOps Engineer, AI Platform matches the Web.com/Network Solutions posting already in the ledger; Thumbtack SRE postings are US-oriented; Kinaxis Cloud Engineer II is already filed (BuiltIn, 2026-10-05).

notes_sections.heading: October 1 run
items: Discovery used the logged-in browser plus LinkedIn’s public job-search listing endpoint (read-only; no state changes). The endpoint ignores the Remote filter, so each relevant listing’s Remote/Hybrid/On-site label was read from its job page. Remote hubs (Toronto, Vancouver, Montréal, Calgary, Ottawa, Edmonton, Kitchener, Halifax, Winnipeg, Québec City, Victoria) each ran DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineer, and the hybrid passes for Ottawa, Kingston, Cornwall and Montréal each ran five title searches; every pass returned its page of 10 (Kingston and Cornwall returned very few, Edmonton SRE none new).

Each pass shows page 1 only (10 results) for the past 2 days; passes after the first were deduplicated against earlier ones, so counts are new-unseen results. Only shortlisted listings were opened; the rest were excluded on title or workplace label alone and are not rows.
Montréal hybrid was almost entirely 3–4 office days (CGI, Vasco, others) or on-site. Barracuda’s employer page gives no office-day count; confirm ≤2 before applying.

notes_sections.heading: September 24 run (incomplete — browser-control resets)
items: Completed and audited: 7 of 14 Canada-remote phrase passes: DevOps Consultant Remote, DevOps Specialist Remote, DevOps Engineer Remote, Senior DevOps Engineer Remote, Staff DevOps Engineer Remote, Senior Site Reliability Engineer Remote, and Platform Engineer Remote. Each used Canada, Remote, and f_TPR=r172800; rendered counts ranged from 22 to 300+ and 7 visible results were reviewed per completed pass.

The second phrase batch reached Senior Platform Engineer Remote, Cloud Engineer Remote, Infrastructure Engineer SRE Remote, DevSecOps Engineer Remote, and Deployment Engineer Remote, but the browser-control session reset before their rendered counts and result IDs could be captured reliably. Those passes, the final two phrase searches, all 11 remote-hub passes, and all 20 reachable-city hybrid passes are recorded as incomplete rather than inferred from snippets.

Blackpoint Cyber — Director of SRE is current and Canada-remote, but the exact company/title already exists as Skipped in applications.md. The accessible LinkedIn description confirms strong Azure/AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, observability and incident-response alignment; the decisive gap remains the required 5+ years managing an SRE team. It was not re-filed.

Autodesk — Senior DevOps Developer is current on Autodesk's employer site (requisition 26WD99916) and remote across Canada. It is a strong CI/CD, IaC, reliability and security-operations match, but applications.md already contains the same company and exact title, including an Applied row. The prior pipeline decision was preserved and no duplicate was filed.

SecurityScorecard's Senior Forward Deployed Engineer appeared as a fresh Greater Ottawa remote result, but a complete authoritative description could not be recovered during this run; it remains unscored under Could not validate.
No LinkedIn write-side action occurred: no save, apply, follow, message, alert, reaction, or profile change.

notes_sections.heading: September 22 run (partial — 3 of 14 phrase passes)
items: Boundary reached this run: only the first 3 of the 14 mandatory Canada-remote phrase passes ("DevOps Consultant Remote", "DevOps Specialist Remote", "DevOps Engineer Remote") were completed; the remaining 11 phrase passes, all 11 remote-hub passes, and all 20 reachable-city hybrid passes were not reached this run — a genuinely fresh full 45-pass rotation is still owed on a future run. Each completed pass used geoId=101174742 (Canada) and f_TPR=r172800 (rendered as "Past week" per the known LinkedIn label quirk).

Confirmed the known feed-collapse pattern again: the "DevOps Engineer Remote" phrase (pass 3) opened on an identical top-of-list to "DevOps Consultant Remote" (pass 1) before diverging further down after scrolling — consistent with prior runs' notes on LinkedIn's recommendation engine converging across similarly-worded queries.

Best new match: Clio — Systems Engineer, Azure Infrastructure (score 8, Platform). Remote Eastern Canada excluding Quebec, CAD $119K–$161K. Strong Azure/AKS/Kubernetes/IaC alignment. This is a pipeline match — Marc already has an Applied row for this exact company+title from 2026-07-07 (Manual) — status preserved as Applied, not re-filed.

ComPsych — Senior DevSecOps Engineer (score 8, DevOps) is also a pipeline match: same company+exact title already Applied 2026-09-01 via Indeed. USD $150K–$200K, and the role's AI-directed-CI/CD framing lines up closely with Marc's actual AI-assisted-engineering work at Énergir. Status preserved as Applied.

Tailscale — Infrastructure Engineer (score 6, Platform) is a third pipeline match — Applied 2026-07-07 (Manual). CAD $218K–$273K is exceptional pay, but the role reads more like a Go-heavy Software Engineer position than pure infrastructure/SRE; status preserved as Applied.

Estoras Group — AWS and DevOps Engineer (score 6, DevOps) is a same-day cross-board duplicate: already auto-filed today via Built In. Remote Canada contract, bilingual FR/EN asset, AWS hosting/IaC/monitoring scope. Status shown as New, not re-filed.

4 genuinely new auto-filed: AuthZed Senior SRE-Security (score 5 — strong Kubernetes/IaC baseline but the role's real center of gravity is security engineering/IAM/PKI, a gap not a blocker), Highspring/Vaco Bilingual DevOps/SRE-AWS (score 6 — Montreal hybrid, mandatory AWS certification Marc doesn't hold, distinct req from Marc's existing Highspring vetting relationship), Myticas Consulting DevOps Specialist-Kubernetes (score 5 — Ottawa fully on-site, strong Azure/AKS match, rate unstated), Techso DevOps Specialist AWS/Azure (score 7 — Montreal flexible hybrid, genuine multi-client consulting firm, bilingual FR/EN required, strong positioning fit).

7 ineligible on geography alone (score -1, not opened beyond the listing location line since the gate is dispositive): Thomson Reuters Staff Platform Engineer-Materia AI (Toronto hybrid), Nasdaq DevOps Cloud Engineer (Toronto on-site), Celestica AI DevOps Specialist (Toronto hybrid), J&M Group Senior DevSecOps Engineer (Toronto hybrid), Rogers Communications FinOps Sr Cloud Engineer (Toronto on-site), Arista Networks Senior SRE-CloudVision (Vancouver on-site), Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies Senior SWE Cloud Platform (Vancouver hybrid), BCAA Solution Specialist II Infrastructure (Burnaby hybrid) — all outside the Ottawa/Kingston/Brockville/Cornwall/Montréal reachable range.
DEFSEC Technologies Senior Configuration Management Specialist (Ottawa hybrid) is ineligible on rate alone: CAD $65K–$85K is below the $100K on-site/hybrid FTE floor for Ottawa.

4 out-of-scope by domain (score 0): Ciena Senior Release Engineer-Linux Distribution (Yocto/Bitbake build engineering, not DevOps/platform/SRE), Saputo IT Project Manager (PM, not engineering), Marqeta Senior Security Engineer-IAM and micro1 Backend Security Engineer (deep security/backend-software specialist roles), Kake Senior Rust Engineer (software engineering), Jobright.ai Cloud Engineer-Early Career (junior).

Newfold Digital (Bluehost) Principal Engineer (score 2, SRE, Nova Scotia remote) requires expert-level Perl/cPanel/MySQL hosting-platform depth Marc has no exposure to — below the filing bar despite a real SRE component.
Micrologic — Gestionnaire Infrastructure Cloud & DevOps resurfaced unchanged from the Sep 21 run; status (Skipped — 2-year people-management requirement) preserved, not re-scored.

notes_sections.heading: September 21 latest run
items: 45 mandatory passes completed: 14 Canada-remote title phrases, 11 remote-hub discovery passes, and 20 hybrid title/city passes across Ottawa, Kingston, Cornwall, and Montréal. All used LinkedIn's reliable Past 24 hours filter because its attempted 48-hour parameter rendered as Past week.

Best current match: Syntax — Senior Platform Engineer (SRE), AI Solutions. The fresh repost matches Marc's existing Applied pipeline row by company and exact role, so its status remains Applied. Azure, Terraform, GitOps, observability, incident response, AI-assisted engineering and automation align well; deep Kubernetes/CNCF and Backstage ownership remain the main gap.

ClearGov — Senior DevOps Engineer: strong developer enablement, Terraform, CI/CD, observability, incident response and AI-guardrail alignment. The decisive mismatch is deep hands-on AWS architecture; compensation is CAD $110K–$140K, above the remote floor but below the aspirational target.

Sage Recruiting client — Staff Platform Engineer: exceptional pay at CAD $210K–$260K plus equity, but the role explicitly demands production Go, deep AWS, and extensive Kubernetes cluster operations, making it a stretch despite strong ownership, Terraform, reliability and AI-workflow overlap.

LinkedIn read-only audit: Kingston and Cornwall returned zero with the Hybrid filter. Required unfiltered reruns were completed; the visible results were Canada-remote roles rather than local hybrid candidates. No CAPTCHA, checkpoint, or login loss occurred.

notes_sections.heading: September 18 latest run
items: Best new match: Hunter Bond — Platform Engineer. Montréal hybrid with CAD $180K base, strong Linux/Python/Terraform/Ansible/Puppet/Kubernetes alignment; office cadence is not disclosed and must be confirmed at two days/week or less.

Strong Azure contract lead: Raas Infotek — DevOps Architect. Excellent Azure, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD and reliability alignment; the poster-added 8+ years Terraform and 6+ years Python requirements are the main risk, and no rate was stated.
CANARIE is a strong senior platform role in Ottawa, but the CAD $125K–$169K range partly falls below the hybrid floor and the cadence is undisclosed.
Elastic is an exact pipeline match already applied through Built In on Sep 18; the fresh LinkedIn posting confirms CAD $138.3K–$185.9K and active hiring.

Excluded after full validation: Alpen Labs (must be based in the United States), QUANTEAM (four Montréal office days/week), Aptiv/Wind River (CAD $95K–$120K hybrid), and TELUS Health (CAD $49K–$89.7K). Chainlink remains scored low because deep Kubernetes internals/Operators, production AWS and Go are core requirements.

notes_sections.heading: September 18 rerun
items: Best fresh match: Syntax Senior Platform Engineer (SRE), AI Solutions. Azure, Terraform, GitOps, observability, incident response and automation align well; deep Kubernetes/CNCF and Backstage ownership are the main gaps.
StackAdapt is well paid and remote, but requires strong production AWS plus significant Kubernetes node and deployment-pipeline ownership.
Chainlink Labs is globally remote and platform-focused, but explicitly requires deep Kubernetes internals, Operators, production AWS and Go.
Stripe was freshly reposted and remains retained at 4/10; its five-year full-stack minimum is still the decisive mismatch.

GitLab's Engineering Manager result was excluded because the profile does not support current engineering people-management scope. Repario and Avenue Code were not scored because their full eligibility/requirements could not be established during this pass.

notes_sections.heading: September 18 decisions
items: Syntax and StackAdapt: Marc applied to both Sep 18 with tailored resumes and cover letters; recorded as Applied in applications.md.
GSPANN Technologies (AI Observability & Platform Engineer): skipped by Marc's explicit call — not pursued.
Undisclosed — Senior Cloud Platform Engineer and Stripe — Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services: both confirmed by Marc as no longer accepting applications; relabeled Expired.

notes_sections.heading: Validation limits
items: Boundary: the 14 default phrase families were covered through public discovery queries, plus one authenticated Canada-remote LinkedIn pass with the past-two-days URL filter. LinkedIn displayed “Past week” despite the requested 48-hour parameter.
Three new postings were fully validated on LinkedIn; no employer-site recovery was needed. Four additional visible results were excluded or left unvalidated.
The per-hub and per-city result grids were not exhaustively paginated; no eligible Kingston or Cornwall posting surfaced. Search activity was read-only.
